properties.name: Indus River dolphin
properties.story: ~1,800 individuals in Sindh. 6 dolphins rescued from stranded irrigation canals after the flood.

properties.name: Hog deer
properties.story: Riverine-forest dweller in Sindh; habitat lost to sediment burial of seedlings.

properties.name: Smooth-coated otter
properties.story: Indus wetlands dweller; sensitive to post-flood agro-chemical runoff.

properties.name: Marsh crocodile
properties.story: Manchar Lake population displaced when the protective embankment was breached.

properties.name: White-rumped vulture
properties.story: Riverine-forest nester; one of only a few hundred remaining in Pakistan.
